(Lodged In Dist. Jail,
Merta).
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through PP  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Mahendra Kumar Dudy.

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mukesh Trivedi, PP.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 18/08/2023 This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.325/2022 registered at Police Station Parbatsar, District Nagaur, for offences under Sections 363, 344 and 376(2)(n) IPC and Section 5(L)/6 of the POCSO Act.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the prosecutrix who is aged about 17 years, was having consensual relationship with the present petitioner who is aged about 20 years.

Drawing attention of the Court towards the statements of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. before the Magistrate concerned on 03.05.2023, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the prosecutrix voluntarily eloped with the present petitioner and remained in his company and travelled with him to Surat (Gujarat) and various other places using public transportation.

Learned counsel submitted that the prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., has clearly (2 of 2) [CRLMB-10164/2023] denied the allegation of forcible sexual assault against the petitioner.

Learned counsel submitted that in view of the fact that the prosecutrix has denied the allegation of she being abducted or subjected to forcible sexual assault by the petitioner; challan has been filed Sampat vs State Of Rajasthan on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9754002/
1 and the petitioner is in custody since 30.04.2023, the petitioner deserves to be enlarged on bail.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.
Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Sampat S/o Sh. Naurat Ram arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.325/2022 registered at Police Station Parbatsar, District Nagaur, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/-
each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 198-Tikam/-
